title: Deployment Guide
scope_summary: How to build, run, and distribute the BoosterSimApp macOS menu-bar app. Covers development build prerequisites (macOS 15, Xcode 16.3+), build commands, first-run onboarding with Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions, and future distribution plans including code signing, notarization, DMG creation, sandboxing tradeoffs, and semantic versioning.
